gen-dafont-electroharmonix-fs-merriweath: Striking, Electroharmonix splits each word into single letters with open gaps and generously curved rounds. Merriweather Sans is the sturdy partner, making words look large and solid, with an e that opens clearly to the right.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-fs-merriweathe: Merriweather Sans makes its words look sturdy and large, with an e whose eye opens clearly to the right. Merriweather Sans stays quiet beneath Neuropolitical, whose letters look like glowing glass tubing pulled apart one by one.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-fs-be-vietnam-pr: Letters pushed far apart by generous tracking give Ethnocentric a fast, aggressive stride, with short ascenders sitting above big bowls. Be Vietnam Pro reads smoothly, its curve endings never crowding each other.
gen-dafont-stentiga-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans makes its words look large, with an e whose eye opens clearly to the right. Stentiga does refined, luxurious, stencil-cut spacing; Merriweather Sans does sturdy, solid reading.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-epilogue: Paprika scatters its letters far apart, lowercase filling the line like capitals. Epilogue sits beneath with curvy, wire-like monoline letters and stubby ascender tips, with no stroke modulation at all.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-cascadia-code: Cascadia Code spaces its letters at a noticeable distance, with bars matching its upright stems in weight. And Paprika scatters its own letters apart, lowercase filling the line like capitals.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-work-sans: Wide bridges between letters give Snowburst One the look of a stencil sheet, bold and expressive. Work Sans stays composed and contemporary, its c tips never creeping toward touching and its mean line set high.
gen-gf-tektur-manrope: Tektur has generous openings on every curve and outsized lowercase. Manrope opens a bright gap at each curved letter's mouth, and Tektur does its best work big and short.
gen-gf-unica-one-satoshi: A very large lowercase eye gives Unica One visible daylight inside every curve. Satoshi brings a high x-height and a wide e, though Unica One would lose that daylight if made small.
gen-gf-wallpoet-switzer: Switzer reads like tubular wire, approachable and distinctly Swiss in feel. Wallpoet, bold and commanding with paper showing through between its letters, does its best work big and short.
